name: prompt-enhancer
description: /enhance <text> opens an Enhance pane that rewrites your draft one of two ways, in one model call: Cleaned up (a cheap model fixes typos, fillers, voice-to-text artifacts and punctuation, nothing else) or Expanded (a short, clear prompt written with the conversation). Use it, send it or copy it.

cleanModel.title: Cleaned up model
cleanModel.description: The model that cleans up a draft, with no conversation: haiku (the default), sonnet, opus or a full model id.

model.title: Expanded model
model.description: session (the default): this session's own model, reading the conversation from the prompt cache. Or haiku, sonnet, opus or a full model id: that model, sent the last messages of the conversation as an excerpt.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard Expanded's model thinks when it is not session. default: the model's own.
